attributes.context: This provision is part of a broader agreement to establish a Joint Safety and Health Committee to discuss safety problems and recommendations.

extraction_text: The State and the Union agree to set up a subcommittee of the State Health and Safety Committee to discuss the use of VDT machines in State Departments. Included in the discussions will be the Department of Health Guidelines on the use of VDT machines. The subcommittee will consist of four management representatives and four Union representatives. The subcommittee may make recommendations to the Commissioner of the Department of Labor as to future PEOSHA regulations. The subcommittee will meet quarterly. The committee shall meet within 90 days after the contract is signed.
